basic_info.description: Experience resort-style living just minutes from Chase Center, Oracle Park, The Embarcadero, Spark Social, and more in this spacious 2BD / 2BA modern residence at Madrone. Offering 1,396 sq ft of thoughtfully designed space and surrounded by lush greenery, Residence #311 includes a private attached terrace, perfect for indoor-outdoor living. Residents enjoy one of the city's best amenity collections: a 24/7 attended lobby, 75-ft heated lap pool, spa, sauna, fitness studio, outdoor grill/lounge, billiards room, and private movie theater. Inside, wide plank floors lead to an expansive living/dining area filled with natural light from oversized windows. The chef's kitchen features premium finishes, quartz countertops, a custom mosaic backsplash, Bosch appliances, and a Thermador refrigerator. The spacious primary suite boasts floor-to-ceiling windows, 2 walk-in closets, and an elegant en-suite bath with dual vanities and a glass-enclosed shower. The 2nd bedroom is well-sized, ideal for guests or a home office, and offers a closet and an adjacent 2nd full bathroom. Additional features include central A/C, in-unit laundry, same-level private storage room (not a cage), dedicated bike storage, and 1-car garage parking.
